fusions.name: Quick Snatch
fusions.desc: A reaching grab on a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Short Change
fusions.desc: Flicks a coin that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it, and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Return to Sender
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Nimble Fingers
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. Your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
